note_title: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略

callouts.id: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略#1
callouts.title: 基本的思路
callouts.body:
1. 在测度空间当中，我们要证明一个集合$A$为零测度，即$\mu(A) =0$，但是这件事通常并不好直接展开。
2. 于是转而把命题修改为，证明$A_{\varepsilon}$这个集合对于$\forall \varepsilon >0$都有$\mu(A_{\varepsilon})=0$.
3. 证明的思路无非就是，用一些更大的集合去覆盖$A_{\varepsilon}$，然后证明这种覆盖其测度的上界可以任意小，即$$\mu(A_{\varepsilon})<r,\forall r>0$$也就是说用一个与参数$r$有关的一族集合去覆盖$A_{\varepsilon}$,并通过调整$r$使得这一族集合的测度可以任意小。或者可以利用一些现成的对集合的控制，比如一些weak-type的不等式。总之无非就是估计把问题转换为估计$A_{\varepsilon}$。

classification_result.id: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略#1

if_strategy_template.summary_en: To prove a set has measure zero, replace the original target by auxiliary sets such as $A_{\varepsilon}$ and estimate their measures instead. The core move is to cover $A_{\varepsilon}$ by larger sets whose total measure can be made arbitrarily small, or to control them using available weak-type estimates.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when proving that a set has measure zero directly is difficult, but one can instead estimate related enlarged or auxiliary sets and show their measures can be made arbitrarily small.

callouts.id: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略#2
callouts.title: 本问题意义下的分布函数的定义
callouts.body: $(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$是一个测度空间$f:X\to \mathbb{C}$是一个$(\mathcal{F},\mathcal{B}(\mathbb{C}))$的可测函数,也就是$\mathcal{B}(\mathbb{C})$当中元素关于映射$f$的原像是$\mathcal{F}$当中的元素。定义$$\lambda_f(a):=\mu(\{x:|f(x)| >a\})$$

callouts.id: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略#3
callouts.title: 这种分布函数的基本性质
callouts.body:
1. $\lambda_f$是一个单调减少并且右连续的函数。
2. 如果$|f|\leq |g|$那么$\lambda_f \leq \lambda_g$
3. 如果$|f_n|\uparrow |f|$那么$\lambda_{f_n}\uparrow \lambda_f$
4. 如果$f = g+h$那么$\lambda_f(a)\leq \lambda_g(a/2)+\lambda_h(a/2)$
5. 如果$f = gh$那么$\lambda_f(a)\leq \lambda_g(\sqrt{a/2})+\lambda_h(\sqrt{a/2})$

classification_result.id: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略#3
classification_result.english_title: Basic Properties of This Distribution Function

if_problem.statement_en: Let $(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$ be a measure space and let $f$ be measurable. Prove the following properties of the distribution function $\lambda_f(a)=\mu(\{x:|f(x)|>a\})$: (1) $\lambda_f$ is decreasing and right-continuous; (2) if $|f|\le |g|$, then $\lambda_f\le \lambda_g$; (3) if $|f_n|\uparrow |f|$, then $\lambda_{f_n}\uparrow \lambda_f$; (4) if $f=g+h$, then $\lambda_f(a)\le \lambda_g(a/2)+\lambda_h(a/2)$; (5) if $f=gh$, then $\lambda_f(a)\le \lambda_g(\sqrt{a/2})+\lambda_h(\sqrt{a/2})$.
prerequisites: continuity from above and below of measures

callouts.id: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略#4
callouts.title: 启示
callouts.body: 如果我们要估计$\lambda_f(\alpha)$,那么可以尝试放大$|f|$,或者放大以后再把函数分解为更简单，更熟悉，分布函数更好估计的函数,比如$$|f| \leq |g|+|h|$$此时$$\lambda_f(\alpha)\leq \lambda_g(\alpha/2)+\lambda_h(\alpha/2)$$这样我们可以利用一些已有的弱估计的结论。

classification_result.id: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略#4

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Estimate distribution functions by domination and decomposition
if_strategy_template.summary_en: To estimate $\lambda_f(\alpha)$, dominate $|f|$ by a larger or simpler expression and then decompose it into pieces with more manageable distribution functions. This lets one transfer known weak estimates to the original function.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when a direct estimate of the distribution function of $f$ is hard, but $f$ can be bounded or decomposed into simpler functions such as $g$ and $h$.

callouts.id: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略#5
callouts.title: 问题1
callouts.body: 证明在sigma-finite的测度空间$(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mu)$上，**对于非负可测函数$f$，在一个测度为正的集合$E$上的积分$\int_{E}f\,d\mu =0$那么$f =0$在集合$E$上几乎处处成立。**

classification_result.id: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略#5

if_problem.statement_en: Prove that on a $\sigma$-finite measure space $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mu)$, if $f$ is a nonnegative measurable function and $\int_E f\,d\mu=0$ for a measurable set $E$ with positive measure, then $f=0$ almost everywhere on $E$.
key_techniques: distribution function or superlevel set argument
positivity of the integral of a nonnegative function

callouts.id: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略#6
callouts.title: 问题2
callouts.body: 证明连续函数$f:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$的图像$$G:=\{(x,y):y=f(x)\}$$在$\mathbb{R}^2$的Lebesgue测度下是零测度的。

classification_result.id: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略#6

if_problem.statement_en: Prove that the graph of a continuous function $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, namely $$G:=\{(x,y):y=f(x)\},$$ has Lebesgue measure zero in $\mathbb{R}^2$.
key_techniques: covering the graph by thin rectangles
